newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares add on, market seen edgy.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares add on, market seen edgy.

text.p: Slovenian shares firmed on Wednesday and traders are pinning their hopes on further gains if parliament ratifies the EU association treaty.
Trading seen volatile over the short term.
"If the agreement is ratified, the index could climb by up to 30 percent over the next two to three months," one broker said.
Failure to ratify the accord, may keep foreign buyers away for several months, driving the SBI index down to its December levels around 1,150, traders said.
Parliament last week postponed a vote on whether to ratify the EU association accord, which was signed in June 1996, to allow political parties more time to reach broader agreement on the issue.
* The SBI index rose 12.84 points to 1,315.44.
* Overall eight shares rose, eight fell and 12 were untraded.
